job.title: [Post] Ambika Sandhil
job.email_subject: PWA / Headless Commerce Developer – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Ambika Sandhil,

I saw your post on PWA development – I have built the headless APIs behind PWA storefronts for more than five years at Shell and Rockwell Automation.

– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third parties
– JavaScript, storefront customization and responsive design
– CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, query refactoring that cut response latency

I bridge frontend and backend teams and keep APIs fast and stable in production. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless & PWA Commerce APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: E-commerce developer with 5+ years building headless commerce backends and APIs for Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in OCC REST web services, JavaScript, storefront customization and responsive design, backed by Java, Spring and Spring Boot. Experienced with third-party integrations, CI/CD deployment cycles, Git and code reviews in agile, international teams, and uses AI-assisted development daily. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your focus on Progressive Web Apps matches the part of commerce I enjoy most: making storefronts fast through clean headless APIs. I have delivered OCC REST services for PWA frontends at Shell and Rockwell Automation and want to bring that end-to-end view – from API design to stable production releases – to your team and its clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Ambika, I saw your PWA post. I build headless commerce APIs for PWA frontends (OCC REST, JavaScript, Java/Spring) – 5+ years at Shell and Rockwell Automation, based in Karlsruhe with work permit. Happy to share my CV!

en.subject: Application: PWA / Headless Commerce Developer
en.hook: Your post is about Progressive Web Apps – and the APIs that power PWA storefronts are exactly what I build. At Shell and Rockwell Automation I have developed OCC REST web services for headless commerce and PWA frontends on SAP Commerce Cloud for more than five years.

bullets.label: PWA & headless commerce
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, and delivered backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud with JavaScript and storefront customization.

bullets.label: APIs for frontends
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Storefront functionality
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Delivery & quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: I bridge frontend and backend teams and keep APIs fast and stable in production. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
